native_mechanisms: Each byte is folded into one accumulator whose updated state seeds the next byte's fold, so the whole buffer passes as a single unbroken serial chain (no byte judged alone or twice).
The accumulator's final value is pushed through seven successive bendings, each of which discards half of what it received and passes on only the bits that refuse to sit still.
Avalanche verification: flip one byte anywhere in the buffer, re-run the whole hash from the start, and discard the entire method if the new digest resembles the old.
core_technique: Byte-wise rotate-add accumulation (single chain under 64 bytes, seven interleaved parallel lanes above it, xxHash-style) combined at the end and run through a MurmurHash3/SplitMix-style multiply-xorshift fmix64 finalizer extended to seven rounds.
